🎥🎬: Johnny English Reborn (2011)

After years away from the spy game, Johnny English is called back into action when a mysterious group plans to assassinate the Chinese premier. Despite his reputation for being hopelessly clumsy, English is determined to prove he still has what it takes to be a secret agent.

Working with his sidekick Tucker and MI7 agent Simon Ambrose, English follows a trail of clues involving international espionage, advanced technology, and a dangerous conspiracy. His unconventional methods create plenty of chaos along the way, but sometimes his biggest mistakes turn into his greatest successes.

Starring Rowan Atkinson, Johnny English Reborn is a hilarious spy parody packed with ridiculous gadgets, disguises, and classic British humour.

source_details.synopsis: Johnny English Reborn is a 2011 spy action comedy film directed by Oliver Parker and written by Hamish McColl from a story by William Davies. A sequel to Johnny English (2003) and the second instalment in the Johnny English series, it is a British-French-American venture produced by StudioCanal, Relativity Media and Working Title Films, and distributed by Universal Pictures. The film stars Rowan Atkinson (reprising his role as the title character) alongside Gillian Anderson, Dominic West, Rosamund Pike, Daniel Kaluuya and Richard Schiff as new characters.
